messages:
Sam: Quick thought — can we simplify the hosted/dedicated/private proxy layer by making the request proxy orthogonal to HostingMode? Instead of mode-specific sidecars, have a small ModeProxy interface in the control plane that picks routing + transforms, then calls a single runtime ingress path.
Tara: I like the idea. How would auth and tenant isolation work? main worry is leaking hosted assumptions into private runtime.
Sam: Keep auth tokens intact; ModeProxy only rewrites routing headers & selects model variant. Private deployments set proxy=passthrough. Runtime must always validate tenant certs on ingress. No auth material should be injected by hosted-only proxies.
Devon: Two concerns: added hop = latency, and telemetry attribution getting fuzzy.
Maria: For latency we can piggyback the proxy logic into the edge gateway for hosted to avoid an extra network hop. For dedicated/private the runtime can register a small local-adapter so calls stay local.
Sam: Minimal manifest tweak proposal (sketch):
```yaml
hosting:
  mode: hosted # | dedicated | private
  proxy:
    strategy: edge-inject | local-adapter | passthrough
```
Tara: Nice. What about fallback semantics when capacity is constrained? If hosted falls back to dedicated, should the proxy strategy change?
Devon: Fallback should map strategy -> local-adapter when edge can't reach dedicated. That implies a small translation table in the control plane and a probe to check adapter reachability.
Maria: Observability requirement: trace ids and cost attribution must survive transformations. Propose header 'x-rw-trace' and 'x-rw-cost-origin' propagated by ModeProxy.
Sam: Also need clear guarantees: ModeProxy may modify routing headers but MUST NOT mutate user prompt or K/V cache keys. Otherwise cache correctness breaks.
Tara: Ops plan: A/B the proxy-less flow for a subset of tenants, gated by feature flag 'mode_proxy_v2'. Start with low-risk read-only endpoints.
infra-bot: deploy queued: canary for mode_proxy_v2 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Devon: Action item — I will run perf baselines comparing edge-inject vs local-adapter for 1k concurrent requests.
Maria: I'll draft telemetry change doc and header contract. Need to include tracing, sampling, and billing tags.
Sam: I'll open the RFC PR with interface sketch + opt-in flag and include the manifest snippet + probe plan. Target by EOD.
Tara: Sounds good. No blockers from product side. :+1:
Devon: one thing — we should add a short-circuit for latency-sensitive routes so ModeProxy can be bypassed if hop cost > threshold.
Sam: Agreed, add 'latency_threshold_ms' to strategy config and control-plane decisioning.
Maria: lgtm.
Sam: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC link here when created.
Tara: Thanks.
Devon: cool
Maria: thanks
thread_text_excerpt: Simplify mode-specific proxies by orthogonal ModeProxy + manifest strategy, plan A/B rollout, telemetry and perf tasks
